amends: native-protocol-r1.json startup platform and isolation only; full-population measurement remains future gated work

runner.trigger: push on controller-created disposable run branch, never merged

rules: Stage linux-x64 instead of the measured non-working local ARM route; ARM observations are explicitly unreceipted and grant no metric. Verify the full pinned455file payload before vendor execution.

Use kernel user/network/PID namespaces with unshare --user --map-root-user --net --pid --fork --kill-child; measure PID1 and loopback-only interfaces; no unisolated fallback. Kill normal and timeout process groups; PID namespace exit kills detached descendants.
Preflight before download reports a fixed failed-stage enum and integer/null kernel capabilities; raw stderr and exception text remain private.

Keep payload, HOME and private outputs outside checkout on an ephemeral runner; no credentials or subsequent execution from the vendor-exposed checkout. Only a separately published schema-validated receipt.json may leave the runner.
Run three authored API variants independently after bounded readiness polling; completion requires clean shutdown. Startup is not a calibration metric or complete native population proof.
Runner explicitly selects free>=1GiB on cache/output filesystems and load<=6, nice10; lane defaults remain20GiB/load6. No Docker, global install, Rosetta, paid call or Azure login.
The staged workflow remains calibration/oracles/azure-policy/probe-linux-x64.workflow.yml until the controller copies it to the run branch. L3 remains held by D19.
artifact: receipt.json only; counts, hashes, fixed enums and flags; never raw LSP, evaluations or stderr
